content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the causes and symptoms of Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes
Explain how diabetes affects blood glucose control
Compare the treatments for Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes
Describe the long-term complications of uncontrolled diabetes

is a condition where blood glucose levels are not properly controlled. It occurs when the body either cannot produce enough insulin (Type 1) or cannot respond properly to insulin (Type 2). Diabetes is a growing global health problem affecting hundreds of millions of people.

Type 2 diabetes: insulin resistance, often lifestyle-related, treatable with diet/exercise/medication
